story_type: swimmer lowered over whitecaps to a fishing boat far offshore, basket hoist
hook: 120 miles out, his ride home hung from a cable.
narration: This fisherman was a hundred and twenty nautical miles off Nantucket, and his ride home hung from a cable.
He was fifty-five, aboard the sixty-seven-foot fishing boat Sassy Girl, and he needed a medevac.
Out that far, there is no quick boat ride to shore, so Coast Guard Air Station Cape Cod sent a helicopter crew.
First, the rescue swimmer swung out the door, over open water.
The hoist operator lowered him toward the boat through the rotor wash, guiding the cable with one hand.
From the cockpit, the pilot can't see what's directly below, so the hoist operator talks him into position, foot by foot.
[short pause] Then the basket came back up the cable, with the fisherman inside.
outcome: The fisherman made it into the helicopter, and the Cape Cod crew flew him off the Sassy Girl.
title: Swimmer lowered 120 miles off Nantucket
description:
On July 20, 2019, Coast Guard Air Station Cape Cod aircrews medevaced a 55-year-old fisherman off the 67-foot fishing boat Sassy Girl, 120 nautical miles off Nantucket, Massachusetts.
